methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The UNEP Ozone Secretariat hosts the Montreal Protocol treaty texts, handbooks, amendments (Kigali etc.) and depositary notifications at https://ozone.unep.org/treaties/montreal-protocol. The site is server-rendered Drupal HTML with direct PDF links, not a SPA.

## Search
No document search API or verified search-URL template for this page. Discovery is by browsing the treaty page and its handbook/amendment sections.

## Filters
None as URL parameters. Documents are grouped by section (Handbooks, amendments, depositary notifications) and language (EN/ES/FR/AR/CH/RU), inferable from the URL path and filename.

## Download
Direct PDF. Links live under /sites/default/files/ with dated or Handbook subfolders, e.g. /sites/default/files/Handbooks/MP-Handbook-2020-English.pdf and /sites/default/files/2019-04/...pdf. No authentication required.

## Metadata & Enrichment
No DSpace/record API for documents. Metadata parsed from link text and filename. The Online Reporting System at https://ors.ozone.unep.org/ is a separate country-data submission backend (emissions, HFC-23, contributions) and does not serve these treaty documents. Enrichment mode is none.

## Limitations
Server-rendered so no headless browser required. There is no keyword search endpoint, so only browseAll + direct download are supported.
